dialogues.speaker: Eija
dialogues.text: Honorary Knight! Eija Gretel, at your service! We can begin the flying demonstration and instruction challenge any time you like.

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: Roger that! Vesper, put your best talon forward! Follow the Honorary Knight's instructions carefully.

response.speaker: Vesper
response.text: Shrawrr!

choices.text: Now that I think about it, how does a falcon conduct reconnaissance?

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: You're interested in the technical side of things? Wonderful! It's a little complicated, so I'll try to make things as simple as possible...

response.speaker: Vesper
response.text: Shrawrr!

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: To achieve air-to-ground communication, in addition to making the most of Amber's unparalleled reconnaissance expertise, we also integrated four different technologies...

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: Alchemical equipment from Mondstadt, Gardemek identification devices from Fontaine, principles for controlling overhead surveillance devices from Liyue, and expertise on beast taming from Sumeru.

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: Vesper has undergone special training. It's able to send over more than thirty simple signals to the mechanism on its back by using various tones and movements.

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: These signals are then converted into a coded sequence of flashing lights, which are transmitted to the ground for operators like me to interpret.

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: Similar operational methods have already been field-tested on Liyue's overhead surveillance devices and used to eliminate multiple criminal syndicates and monster swarms. The methodology is proven and reliable.

choices.text: I think I've heard about this before...

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: Apparently, a big exhibition will be held in Nod-Krai soon, and a delegation from Liyue is planning to showcase some even more advanced technology... I'm going to go watch and learn!

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: However, for the time being, the flight instructions sent to Vesper will continue to use the same information chain that I detailed just now.

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: From the ground, we transmit coded light signals. When the mechanism on Vesper's back receives them, it will emit specific tones to tell Vesper what to do.

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: If the visibility is good, it takes less than a second from the moment the order is given for Vesper to react.

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: But if Vesper can't receive the flashing light signals, it will rely on its memory and intuition to return to where it first took off.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Vesper's so clever!

response.speaker: Vesper
response.text: Shrawrr!

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: Indeed. I became neighbors with Vesper when I was only as tall as the Spark Knight, and Vesper was only half as tall as me.

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: Of course, Miss Haniyyah's work, "An Introduction to the Principles of Beast Taming," also played a vital role.

choices.text: Haniyyah? I've heard that name before...

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: Hmm, perhaps you've met her before? I've only read her work, though I'd love to show my gratitude in person...

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: Right now, she's only released a limited run of proof copies, but her book includes a detailed discussion on communicating with animal companions that has benefited me greatly.

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: If I hadn't found her work by chance at a small stall in Nod-Krai...

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: Who knows how many years it would've taken to realize our plans for air-based reconnaissance?

choices.text: Your rapport with Vesper is clearly a key factor!

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: That's true. It's not easy to find a bird of prey as clever and cooperative as Vesper.

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: It's one of the biggest difficulties with trying to popularize a system like this going forward.

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: Still, I'm ready to take on the challenge. I'm going to study my beast-taming socks off — in addition to my regular duties, of course.

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: And as the technology matures, perhaps the signaling equipment will become more compact. That way, birds like pigeons could become viable options, and the training process will become more standardized.

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: Just you wait, Honorary Knight!

choices.text: You and Vesper are obviously birds of a feather!
Does she have some sort of special insight in this area?
What exactly does a Signals Officer do?

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: Hmm... Do you know Phonia? She's the shining light of the original Signals Officers.

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: It was Phonia who established our operating principles, combining incredible Alchemical technology with cutting-edge experimental tactics.

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: She designed most of the training programs I completed — with the help of the Vice Captain and Leonore, our very first Signals Officer.

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: Then something unexpected must have happened. Once she finished compiling the signals handbook, she was transferred and took up a temporary role as an Intelligence Officer.

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: By the time I got back from Dornman Port, Phonia had taken a leave of absence — I haven't been able to see her since...

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: Hmm... I get the impression it's a complicated situation... But the higher-ups haven't issued an incident report, so I guess that means someone like me doesn't need to know — I'm happy to leave it at that.

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: Based on what I know about Phonia, she'll be back in the game in no time. I respect her too much to think she needs any undue concern from me.

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: Shall we get back to the matter at hand?

choices.text: Good idea, I want to know more.

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: Alright! Let me think... We've already covered the operating principles — however, we've run into a few problems when putting them into practice...

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: For example, echo and beam detection devices remain difficult both to operate and to maintain...

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: An entire team of dedicated technicians would be needed to perform maintenance on the battlefield.

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: These are precision instruments, after all.

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: There's no way around it. This is the difference between theory and application.

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: Outfitting every unit with acoustic sensors or alchemical beam equipment isn't cost-effective. Mondstadt can't afford such technology at the moment.

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: Therefore, we have settled on two different paths — the first is to continue to tackle the key technical challenges.

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: The second is to adopt the relatively simple optical-based methods that I've proposed.

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: The authorities in Liyue have extensive experience in this regard. I plan to keep in touch with Su Ding's team for regular guidance as development progresses...

choices.text: That's a lot to get my head around. Let's continue next time!

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: Sure thing! We can leave it here for now! If you'd like to learn more about the relevant technology, I could probably write a short summary for you.

choices.text: I don't know what happened either...

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: Take care, Honorary Knight. Vesper and I will be ready for inspection whenever.

response.speaker: Vesper
response.text: Shrawrr!
